roles.title: 量化研究员-股票（头部量化私募） / Quantitative Researcher – Equities
roles.eligibility: 硕士 (Master's) minimum; 至少3年国内外量化股票策略研究经验 — at least 3 years of domestic or overseas quantitative equity strategy research experience. Listing is marked as accepting students/新人 but the stated bar is 3 years.
roles.requirements: MSc+ in maths, physics, statistics or CS | 3+ yrs quant equity strategy research (live track record preferred) | Strong probability/statistics foundation | Python, C or C++ | Research on alpha/equity strategies with fund managers
roles.notes: Shanghai Pudong. Posting is entirely in Mandarin and the Shanghai/Beijing entity is a Mandarin-first workplace — assume Mandarin fluency is a hard requirement. Mainland China seat requires a work permit (Z visa / foreigner work permit), routine at this level but adds lead time. The parallel Beijing listing (¥40–60k) is https://www.liepin.com/job/1981430669.shtml but Beijing is out of scope for this pass.

existing_rows_audit.detail: Beijing (Haidian) is Lingjun's headquarters and 量化研究员-股票 is live there at ¥40–60k/month (https://www.liepin.com/job/1981430669.shtml), alongside 资深量化研究员 at ¥45–65k×20薪 (https://www.liepin.com/job/1982927175.shtml) — so the office and the track are real. Two corrections: (1) Beijing is OUT OF SCOPE for this pass — the brief admits Shanghai as the only mainland city, and Lingjun has live Shanghai-Pudong equivalents of every Beijing quant req, so this row should be relocated to Shanghai; (2) the 'recent grads accepted; you qualify' verdict is wrong — every current Beijing and Shanghai QR listing states 至少3年 (3+ years) of quant research experience and a Master's minimum. The only 1–3 year in-scope reqs are the A-share algo/T0 QR and QD roles in Shanghai.

No employer-stated total-comp figure exists on any primary Lingjun page. The range is roughly consistent with the Liepin monthly bases I did see (¥40–60k/mo Beijing QR ≈ ¥480–720k base; ¥45–65k×20薪 senior QR ≈ ¥900k–1.3M), but those are base-only Liepin listings, not total comp, and Liepin is an aggregator. Recommend replacing the single range with the per-role monthly figures now captured in the roles array.

gs.amac.org.cn is a JS-driven search app with no stable deep link, and the two manager record IDs surfaced by search resolved to unrelated firms (上海喜岳投资管理有限公司 and 宁波君润创业投资管理有限公司), so I could not load Lingjun's AMAC record directly. Entity existence is not in doubt — the firm's own site names the registrant as 宁波灵均投资管理合伙企业（有限合伙）, and secondary sources give AMAC registration number P1004526 (reported, unverified). The bare domain is not a usable verification link; the Liepin/LinkedIn req URLs in this file are better.

notes: Coverage and blockers. (1) The firm's own careers page (https://www.lingjuninvest.com/jiaruwomen) lists NO jobs — it only gives talent@lingjuninvest.com and links to a Moka-hosted ATS at https://hr.lingjuninvest.com/social-recruitment/lingjuninvest/46355. That portal returns an infinite 302 redirect loop to itself for any non-browser client, and when forced through with a cookie jar it serves only a JS shell with no job data in the HTML. I could not enumerate the firm's own req list, so NO role in this file could be raised to verified-primary. Everything is marked reported-secondary except Singapore, which is office-unconfirmed. (2) The best available substitute is the firm's verified employer account on Liepin (https://www.liepin.com/company-jobs/8587219/), which carried ~30 live reqs refreshed on 2026-08-04, plus the firm's own LinkedIn company page. Both are aggregators/social by the brief's definition. (3) The firm's own website names no office cities anywhere — only the registered entity 宁波灵均投资管理合伙企业（有限合伙）. Shanghai-Pudong is confirmed by the volume of Shanghai-Pudong reqs on the employer account and by consistent press (eFinancialCareers, Wikipedia: 'offices in Beijing and Shanghai'). Hong Kong is confirmed at entity level only, via the SFC public register (LINGJUN CAPITAL (HONG KONG) LIMITED, code BQH901, CR 2984574, incorporated 2020) — I could not confirm a staffed HK research office, and one secondary source claims the HK entity holds no asset-management licence, which I could not check because the SFC licence panel is JS-rendered. Singapore appears only as a location label on job reqs; no Singapore entity, MAS registration or office was found. No EU, UK or Tokyo presence exists — searches for London, Dublin, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Paris and Tokyo returned nothing, and all sources describe Lingjun as Beijing + Shanghai. (4) MANDARIN: every in-scope posting, including the Hong Kong and Singapore ones, is written entirely in Mandarin and routed through the mainland recruiting team. The one English-language posting found (the PM/QR multi-city req on LinkedIn) states verbatim 'Fluency in both Mandarin and English'. There is no evidence of an English-tolerant seat anywhere at this firm — treat Mandarin fluency as a hard gate across all locations. (5) SENIORITY: the standard bar across Lingjun's QR reqs is Master's + 3 years. The only in-scope reqs matching ~18 months of experience are the two Shanghai A-share algo/T0 roles (QR and QD, 1–3 years, ¥28–40k×18薪), with the Shanghai Quantitative Developer role a plausible third. (6) Direct application by email to talent@lingjuninvest.com is the practical route given the broken ATS.
